verdict.rationale: Bento documents an official CLI with 50+ commands for managing the whole account, including subscriber search, CSV import, tags and fields, events and purchases, broadcasts and sequences, transactional email, and templates. Bento Skills explicitly routes AI agents to the CLI among its MCP, SDK, and n8n surfaces, with safety guidance. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documented details such as installation, authentication, and machine-readable output.
